The '''Boulder Lode Mine''' is a mine located in the northeastern section of the [[Barrens]]. It is controlled by the [[Venture Company]] and seems to have once belonged to the [[Horde]] judging by the [[orc]]ish architecture and Horde banners found around the area. [[Boss Copperplug]] runs this operation.
